title: LLM in the Loop: Creating the PARADEHATE Dataset for Hate Speech Detoxification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of models to rewrite hateful and toxic language (which includes identity-targeted slurs, derogatory content, and offensive speech) into neutral, non-toxic text. The evaluation uses automated metrics including Style Accuracy (via a RoBERTa-based toxicity classifier to ensure removal of harmful language), Content Preservation (cosine similarity of embeddings), Fluency, and BLEU scores.
